78. International Law <10.11

Survivors of victims of September 11, 2001 attacks failed to state cause of action in complaint against two individuals under Torture Victim Protection Act (TVPA), where there were no allegations individu-als acted under color of law. 28 U.S.C.A.

79. War and National Emergency <=50

To adequately plead the provision of material support under the Antiterrorism Act (ATA), a plaintiff has to allege that the defendant knew about the terrorists' illegal activities, the defendant desired to help those activities succeed, and the defendant engaged in some act of helping those activ-ities. 18 U.S.C.A. § 2333(a).

The statute of limitations for assault and battery and intentional infliction of emotional distress claims under New York law is one year. N.Y.McKinney's CPLR 2158).
